title: Example 135: a window counter with the previous count proved equal on the start and the count by the tool's own checker, the record results related on their shared components
description: Regression proof of net.terminalvalue.crosscut.ratelimit.Window#counted by the tool's own bounded model checker (--engine native) across the counter record gaining a previousCount component: the old counter is built from the new components and the two record results are related on the components they share (--results-agree-when 'previous.startNanos == result.startNanos && previous.count == result.count'), with no scope. Expected verified in seconds; JBMC did not finish the same harness within a minute inline (two 64-bit remainders), which is why the example names the checker.
